answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond for a full epoch and tie it to a unique hardware attestation, so one operator cannot mint thousands of cheap copies. A lone fake is a dune, trivial to pile up; a bonded identity is an oasis, because real capital stands behind it. If a duplicate is caught, the bond is slashed and the operator's stake falls to its nadir, making mass forgery unprofitable while honest agents get their bond back.
